Liveness probe: "is the process up?"

Deliberately does no I/O (no DB, no external APIs) so it is cheap and
never fails for reasons unrelated to the process itself. It is pinged
every 10 minutes by the n8n "Elvate — Render Keep-Alive" workflow so the
free Render instance never spins down, and can be used as Render's
Health Check Path.

info.title: Elvate API
info.description:
Elvate shop + digital tools backend.

**Auth**: one httpOnly cookie `session` set by `POST /auth/login` (or Google / face login).
The frontend calls the API through its own `/api/backend` proxy so the cookie stays first-party.
Routes marked *public* need no cookie; routes with **Roles** need one of the listed roles (`/delivery/*` is for the assigned delivery man only).

Money is BDT as JSON numbers; dates are ISO-8601 UTC.

password.description: Current password; omit for Google-only accounts.

addressId.description: Defaults to the user's default address (or the outside-Dhaka fee when there is none).

cashCollected.description: Required for cash on delivery when action is DELIVERED.

isDefault.description: `true` makes it the default. `false` on the default is a 400 (pick another default instead).

value.description: Percent (1–100) for PERCENT, taka for FIXED.

price.description: Overrides the product price; `null` (on PATCH) removes the override.

parentId.description: Omit (or null) for a top-level category.
